summary: Project-local inspection completed without modification. Integration authority: tool-gate is an adapter-free Rust library and CLI providing ARDA’s deterministic pre-execution policy boundary; it evaluates caller-supplied ToolMetadata and InvocationEnvelope data and emits tool-gate.decision.v1 receipts with allow, deny, or review_required decisions (README.md:5-13, README.md:51-61, src/lib.rs:1-8, src/receipt.rs:19-38). Contract evidence: public inputs specify tool identity, risk, mutation/idempotency/review flags, allowed targets, invocation identity, caller, trace, and target (src/types.rs:21-41); policy validates inputs and target scope, requires traces for mutating/reviewable actions, requires mutation idempotency, and routes explicit-review or critical-risk actions to human review (src/policy.rs:23-157). The CLI accepts metadata and invocation JSON, emits the receipt, and maps allow/review/deny to exit codes 0/2/3 (src/main.rs:35-70, src/receipt.rs:30-37). Published JSON Schemas expose all three payload types and pin the receipt schema version and decision vocabulary (schemas/tool-metadata.schema.json:1-15, schemas/invocation-envelope.schema.json:1-15, schemas/decision-receipt.schema.json:1-15). Test sources cover allowed read-only requests, denial for missing mutation traces, critical review routing, receipt JSON, and deny exit code behavior (tests/policy_decisions.rs:34-64, tests/cli_contract.rs:4-35); CI declares formatting, clippy with warnings denied, tests, and documentation checks (.github/workflows/ci.yml:1-12). Declared check outcome: clean-tree PASS; exact command `git diff --exit-code HEAD --` exited 0 with no output. Named integration blockers/dependencies: this project deliberately does not execute tools and provides no tool catalog, queue/storage adapter, authentication, authorization, sandbox, or runtime; an integrating system must supply those components, construct the documented inputs, consume the receipt before side effects, and prevent gate bypass (README.md:5-13, README.md:31-33, README.md:156-158).
